_note: Park-sheet legend. Attractions missing from the interactive map's attractions.json, the sheet's escalators, and a blurb and legend code for every place. Pixel x,y are on the 2678x2190 sheet, traced from the numbered markers and the park's own reference points.

attractions.name: Hong Kong Marine Life Stranding and Education Centre

escalators.name: Escalator to Hotel and Car Park

blurbs.talking-tree: A friendly old tree that chats with young visitors at the edge of Whiskers Harbour.
blurbs.toto-the-loco: A gentle kiddie train that loops through Whiskers Harbour.
blurbs.whiskers-theatre: Indoor theatre for Whiskers and friends' character shows.
blurbs.merry-go-round: Classic carousel with painted horses in the middle of Whiskers Harbour.
blurbs.little-meerkat: Meet the meerkats and Aldabra giant tortoises up close.
blurbs.castle-of-redd: Soft-play castle with slides, tunnels and climbing nets for kids.
blurbs.balloons: Ride hot-air-balloon gondolas round and round above the harbour.
blurbs.jungle-of-giants: A giant jungle playground with oversized plants and climbing frames.
blurbs.village-station: Hop aboard at the little station in the heart of Whiskers Village.
blurbs.whiskers-village: Indoor activity centre with seasonal hands-on workshops for families.
blurbs.explorer-r: Kids' ride on the harbour's eastern edge.
blurbs.whiskers-herbal-valley: A garden of herbs and plants to see, touch and smell.
blurbs.bamboo-zone: Bamboo groves and outdoor stage where Asian animal keepers give talks.
blurbs.gator-marsh: Home to rare Chinese alligators in a lush marsh habitat.
blurbs.giant-panda-adventure: Meet the giant pandas, red pandas and Chinese giant salamanders in a Sichuan-style home.
blurbs.panda-village: Asian small-clawed otters and birds beside the giant pandas.
blurbs.dive-into-local-diversity: Hong Kong's own freshwater creatures, from newts to turtles.
blurbs.marks-mine: Mine-themed exhibit along the Eco-Herbal Trail.
blurbs.eco-herbal-trail: A shaded walking trail up to a waterfall, lined with Chinese herbal plants.
blurbs.ocean-square: The main entrance plaza, with ticketing, lockers and the park gates.
blurbs.croco-land: Crocodiles basking in a tropical pool near the main entrance.
blurbs.conservation-kiosk: Learn how Ocean Park's conservation foundation protects wildlife.
blurbs.aqua-city-lagoon: The lagoon stage for Aqua City's evening water, light and fire show.
blurbs.grand-aquarium: Walk beneath a dome of 5,000 fish, sharks and rays in one of Asia's largest aquariums.
blurbs.sichuan-treasures: Golden snub-nosed monkeys and Sichuan wildlife in a mountain-forest setting.
blurbs.applause-pavilion: Aqua City's pavilion for live shows and animal encounters.
blurbs.ocean-express-waterfront: Board the funicular for a 3-minute ride up through the mountain to the Summit.
blurbs.waterfront-plaza: Open plaza between the Ocean Express station and Old Hong Kong.
blurbs.old-hong-kong: Step back to 1950s–70s Hong Kong: shophouses, snacks and street games.
blurbs.sea-life-carousel: A carousel of ocean animals, with seals, dolphins and sea turtles to ride.
blurbs.sloth-and-friends: Two-toed sloths and other rainforest friends in an indoor studio.
blurbs.cable-car-waterfront: Ride the cable car over the hillside and along the coast to the Summit.
blurbs.marine-life-stranding: Where rescued whales, dolphins and turtles are cared for. Guided tours only.
blurbs.arctic-blast: A family roller coaster racing through polar ice caves.
blurbs.south-pole-spectacular: King, gentoo and rockhopper penguins in an icy Antarctic landscape.
blurbs.north-pole-encounter: Arctic habitats with spotted seals and walruses.
blurbs.ocean-express-summit: The Summit terminus of the Ocean Express funicular.
blurbs.summit-plaza: The Summit's central plaza, beside the Ocean Express station.
blurbs.rainforest-why-zone: Hands-on rainforest discovery zone for curious kids.
blurbs.expedition-trail: A walk through the Amazon rainforest: macaws, poison dart frogs and capybaras.
blurbs.the-rapids: Whitewater river rafting through the rainforest — you will get wet!
blurbs.reptile-territory: Iguanas, skinks and other reptiles in a temple-ruin exhibit.
blurbs.the-flash: A spinning pendulum ride that flips you upside down at speed.
blurbs.whirly-bird: Swing chairs that fly high around a spinning tower.
blurbs.rev-booster: A giant spinning arm that rotates riders 360°.
blurbs.bumper-blaster: Classic bumper cars under the Thrill Mountain canopy.
blurbs.hair-raiser: A floorless coaster at 88 km/h with five inversions over the South China Sea.
blurbs.cable-car-summit: The Summit end of the cable car, back down to the Waterfront.
blurbs.sea-jelly-spectacular: Glowing sea jellies set to light and music.
blurbs.shark-mystique: Walk through a tunnel surrounded by sharks and rays.
blurbs.dolphin-explorations: Watch Indo-Pacific bottlenose dolphins at play in outdoor pools.
blurbs.ocean-park-tower: A revolving cabin climbs 72 metres for 360° views of the South China Sea.
blurbs.pacific-pier: Seals and sea lions on a California-style rocky pier.
blurbs.flying-swing: Swing chairs that fly out over the Marine World headland.
blurbs.ferris-wheel: The Summit's Ferris wheel, with gondolas high above the sea.
blurbs.crazy-galleon: A pirate ship that swings you high above the cliffs.
blurbs.wild-twister: Spin, twist and tilt on the Marine World thrill ride.
blurbs.veterinary-centre: Ocean Park's animal hospital, where vets care for the park's animals.
blurbs.marine-mammal-centre: Behind-the-scenes centre for marine mammal breeding and research.
blurbs.escalator-thrill-mountain: Covered escalator linking Summit Plaza and the Ocean Express with Thrill Mountain.
blurbs.escalator-grand-aquarium: Covered escalator up to The Grand Aquarium entrance.
blurbs.escalator-water-world: Escalator from Pacific Pier down toward Tai Shue Wan and Water World.
blurbs.escalator-bus-interchange: Escalator between Ocean Square and the public bus interchange.
blurbs.escalator-hotel: Escalator between Ocean Square, the hotel and the car park.
